name: Xi'an Tourism Co., Ltd.
summary: Xi'an Tourism Co., Ltd. engages in the management of tourism industry chain. Its business covers the six major tourism elements such as eating, housing, travel, tour, shopping, and entertainment. Its business scope includes travel agencies, restaurants, hotels, entertainment, commerce, tourism services, tourism transportation, scenic area development, real estate development, and commerce. The company was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Xi'an, China.
